verdict:
KILL, and not on valuation - on executability and agency. No escalation trigger fires: benches concordant, no ADVANCE, not held (positions polled at adjudication, HTT absent), and the only near-dated print is a third-party estimate 6 trading days out (see flags).

THE VALUE IS REAL AND IT DOES NOT MATTER. Nobody disputes the arithmetic: US$391M of market cap against ~US$775M of net liquid post-tender, an enterprise value of roughly negative US$384M, and a company that paid US$3.20 cash for 42.8% of its ADSs seven weeks ago. Red did not attack that; it attacked the path, and the path is where the name dies. ADV is 18,203 ADSs (about US$46k/day) while ~6.0M ADSs - 11% of the remaining float - were tendered at <=$3.20, prorated at 88.8%, and are still sitting there wanting out. A $500k starter is more than ten days of total volume and the exit is ~330 trading days of overhang. Per response taxonomy this is a SIZING finding of the structural kind: it caps any position below desk-meaningful size regardless of what the shares are worth, so there is no price at which the ticket becomes real.

BLUE CLOSED RED'S OWN CHANGE-MY-MIND BAR, AND IT FAILED. Red named the decisive unpulled fact precisely: the FY2025 20-F cash note showing >=US$400M held offshore at the Cayman/HK level. Blue got it - parent-level liquid is RMB 1,792.8M cash + RMB 574.3M short-term investments = US$338.5M pre-tender, so roughly US$210M post-tender. That is below red's bar, and it reframes the whole discount: post-tender offshore liquid covers only ~54% of the US$393M cap, so the market is approximately paying for the offshore cash and giving the onshore majority away. With RMB 7.51B of assets (55% of total) sitting inside VIEs behind a WFOE and a withholding-tax wall, against RMB 56M of VIE liabilities, that is a rational price for a minority holder, not a mispricing. Blue also upgraded the restricted-cash finding from PLAUSIBLE to CONFIRMED with the operative quote: the borrowings are secured by standby letters of credit from domestic Chinese banks which are in turn collateralised by the company's restricted cash. The RMB 1,523.7M restricted / RMB 1,576.0M borrowings mirror is a pledge, so the triage's 'add restricted cash -> $6.39/ADS' leg is not incremental value.

THE AGENCY STRUCTURE IS THE REST OF IT. Qufenqi (Luo Min) holds all 63,491,172 Class B at 10 votes = 87.4% of votes post-tender (blue corrected red's 92.5%, which counted only ADSs on the Class A side; substance identical - absolute control). Directors and officers did NOT tender. The Offer to Purchase disclaims any current plan to merge or delist. Roughly US$94M of the March-2024 authorization is undeployed and entirely discretionary. And quarterly reporting went dark - Q1-2026 was skipped, one quarter before management bought 43% of the float. Time works for the controller and against the minority: every quarter of NAV melt and every discounted buyback dollar ratchets his stake cheaper. Blue REDUCED red's melt estimate honestly (annualising the worst quarter overstates it ~1.5x; the structural run-rate is opex minus normalised treasury yield, not US$93M/yr) but the direction holds.

One process credit worth recording: the pack's PRIMARY DOC EXCERPT 404'd on a URL-join bug (a folder base concatenated with an already-absolute URL), which is why the triage's filing claims came back UNVERIFIED. Both benches worked around it rather than inheriting it, and blue's R-file route is a reusable fix that belongs in the bench template.

court.record: batch4 8/15; red 7/blue 8 SUSTAINED (findings 2 and 5 corrected) - outcome CONCORDANT. Blue closed the one decisive coverage gap both benches called unpullable, and it closed ADVERSELY: the 20-F main doc 503s through the proxy, but the per-note XBRL R-files fetch fine, and R31 gives the parent-company liquid balance directly.

reopen_gates: EXECUTABILITY (binding, and it gates everything else): sustained ADV materially above ~18,200 ADSs/day, enough that a desk-meaningful position can be built and exited inside a few weeks. Until this changes, no valuation finding can seat a position - doctrine: a structural sizing kill is not a price gate.

EVENT: a NEW self-tender or special dividend deploying the ~US$94M residual authorization. This is the one action that converts the controller's option premium into minority cash, and it is payable at the parent level where blue proved the money actually is.
EVENT: a Luo Min 13D/A stating take-private intent - converts the squeeze-out RISK into a dated catalyst and inverts the agency finding.

DATA: an H1-2026 6-K restoring quarterly reporting, with positive treasury income and no pivot capex. Voluntary silence from an issuer that chooses whether to print is itself the informed side holding an option.
DATA (secondary): composition of the RMB 1,420M 'other current assets' and the RMB 1,678M aircraft/PP&E line, neither of which is explained anywhere in the results release.
